svg.title: Change in length versus applied force
svg.desc: ΔL rises in proportion to F where Hooke’s law is obeyed, then curves; the material returns to its original length anywhere in the elastic region. Beyond that the deformation is permanent, and the curve rises steeply to the fracture point. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: The companion stays within the linear elastic region: ΔL = F/k.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
